answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging echo-chamber-like staking collateral, establish a mirror-like feedback loop that incentivizes honest agents to maintain their identities, rendering identity cloning computationally infeasible. By imposing slashing penalties for malicious behavior, the system effectively terminates the timber of trust, rendering it unprofitable for attackers to attempt forgery, thereby achieving robust Nash equilibrium and negative expected attack utility, thereby ensuring the long-term resilience of the network against Sybil attacks.
